text:
nina: quick sync note 1: we observed a short tenant spike that triggered soft-reclaim aggressively and caused a cold-start tail.
omar: saw the metric. reclaim happened immediately when credits dipped negative; we need a short hold window.
liang: current linear decay means credits drop too fast for bursty traffic. suggestion: EWMA decay + tiny soft_hold.
tara: agree. propose policy fields: soft_hold_seconds, decay { style: ewma, tau_seconds }, slo_exempt_threshold, headroom_bypass_threshold.
nina: concrete defaults idea: soft_hold=5s, tau=12s, slo_exempt=0.9, headroom_bypass=0.95. conservative by default.
omar: also add a control-plane lease hint `pinned_until_ts` so operator doesn't evict if we plan to use the slots imminently.
liang: operator should honor pinned_until + skew_guard (2s). if headroom low, honor only for high-slo tenants.
tara: need telemetry: counters for reclaim_attempts, reclaim_delayed_by_hold, reclaim_skipped_by_slo, pinned_leases_seen. and trace spans for decisions.
nina: safety circuit: if rolling cold_start_rate(3m) > 0.1 then cut reclaim aggressiveness by 50% and double soft_hold until rate recovers.
omar: edge-case: maintenance drains should be able to override pin. add drain_override flag on drain requests.
liang: implementation notes: expose knobs in CRD with validation. keep defaults conservative; opt-in rollout.
tara: test plan: small sim that replays the spike, unit tests asserting no reclaim within soft_hold, and a canary to staging-1.
orch-bot: rollout ticket INF-4510 created, canary tag `prewarm-safety-v1`, job scheduled on `staging-1`.
nina: action items: (1) CRD + validation (liang) (2) pinned lease + admission hook (omar) (3) telemetry/events/dashboard (tara) (4) sim + PR with traces (nina). i'll open the PR with sim traces today. :thumbsup:
